Name: Browsingway Evolved
Author: Styr1x
Description:
Renders browser overlays in-game to enable playing in fullscreen (and G-SYNC) while having access to ACT overlays.
Use the settings button below or the '/bw config' command to configure.
Based on the BrowserHost plugin by ackwell.
Changelog:
- Overlays recover after the render process restarts, instead of staying on the error screen until the plugin is toggled
- Renamed to Browsingway Evolved (internal name BrowsingwayEvolved) so it can be installed from the EvolvedXIV repository
- Fix the render process randomly failing to start (FileNotFoundException when opening its IPC channel), which needed a game restart to recover
- Api 15
